title: Build an end-to-end leak-free Scikit-learn feature pipeline
brief:
You are designing the feature preprocessing and cross-validation pipeline for a financial credit risk scoring service. The dataset contains continuous financial metrics (income, debt-to-income, credit utilization), high-cardinality categorical attributes (employment industry, merchant category), and missing values. The previous team normalized features before splitting and computed target statistics on the full dataset, creating severe data leakage.

Design a leak-free scikit-learn Pipeline architecture using ColumnTransformer, strict cross-validation, and calibrated linear classification that can safely serialize to production.
deliverables: A modular Scikit-learn Pipeline incorporating ColumnTransformer to route numeric features through StandardScaler and categoricals through OneHotEncoder/TargetEncoder with strict handle_unknown guards
Proper integration of SimpleImputer or KNNImputer inside the pipeline so statistics are fitted solely on training folds
A StratifiedKFold or TimeSeriesSplit cross-validation harness ensuring no test fold data is ever exposed to transformer fit methods
Probability calibration using CalibratedClassifierCV with Platt scaling to convert raw SVM or uncalibrated margins into honest posterior probabilities
Decision threshold tuning against an asymmetric business loss matrix ($50 false positive inquiry cost vs $1,000 false negative default cost)
Model serialization specification with version pinning and input validation schemas
